home.title: OG Doc Admin
home.hint: Select an area from the navigation.
home.noWidgets: No administration areas are currently enabled for your account.

users.resetPermanent: Permanent (no change required at next login)
users.resetHint: By default the password is temporary: the account must choose its own at the next login. You can't reset accounts that hold rights you don't have.
users.resetDoneTemporary: Temporary password set – a new one must be chosen at the next login.

roles.name: Name
roles.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the new role awaits approval by a second person before it is created.

groups.hint: Complements the system's built-in "everyone" group (every authenticated person) with admin-creatable groups that have a real member list - a role assignment to a group applies to every enrolled member.
groups.name: Name
groups.isOrgUnitHint: Flags this group as an org unit - only groups flagged this way count for a dynamic access grant "to the org unit" (four-eyes-style deputization during absence, triggered by workflow-service). Without the flag, no group counts, regardless of membership.
groups.orgUnitToggleError: Failed to change the org-unit flag

orgHierarchy.hint: Assigns one or more supervisors to a person (several are possible, e.g. in matrix organizations). Basis for dynamic access grants and the supervisor overview in one of the next sessions.
orgHierarchy.chainLookupError: Supervisor chain could not be determined
orgHierarchy.chainLookupEmpty: {principalId} has no supervisors (not even indirect ones).

teamspacesAdmin.hint: Installation-wide overview of all teamspaces - independent of your own membership. Creating/deleting/member management stays self-service, this is visibility only.
teamspacesAdmin.name: Name

storageOperationalConfig.hint: Operational parameters of the configured target set - credentials/target list themselves stay env-var-only, these values take effect immediately, without a restart.

signatureConfig.hint: Signature levels per configured connector - the connector list itself stays env-var-only, the levels take effect immediately, without a restart.

retimestampStatus.heading: Archive timestamp renewal (PAdES-B-LTA)
retimestampStatus.hint: Signatures whose archive timestamp chain the automatic background poll loop will renew - purely informational, no manual trigger (a deliberate decision).

approvalSettings.hint: Controls, per action type, whether a second person must confirm the action before it takes effect. An action type missing from the list is not gated (default behavior). A new request notifies the holders of the chosen role (in the app and by e-mail) - without a choice the holders of the required permission, otherwise the "Freigabe-Benachrichtigung" role. Never the requester.
approvalSettings.recipientsNone: nobody - choose a role or grant the "Freigabe-Benachrichtigung" role

emailTemplates.hint: Sets its own subject/body template text per use case (and optionally per recipient domain). If no template is configured for a use case, the built-in default text continues to apply unchanged.
emailTemplates.empty: No templates configured yet - the built-in default texts apply.
emailTemplates.subject: Subject
emailTemplates.domainPlaceholder: optional, e.g. example.com - empty = for all domains
emailTemplates.bodyPlaceholder: e.g. Document {title} will be deleted on {retention_until}.

roleAssignments.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the assignment awaits approval by a second person before it takes effect.

objectTypes.name: Name
objectTypes.kennzeichenFormatHint: Placeholders: {YYYY}/{YY} (year), {MM}/{DD} (month/day), {Laufende_Nummer} (required, reset per year). Leave empty = no automatic file reference number.
objectTypes.classificationLevelHint: Deleted documents of a classified class end up in the structurally separate classified trash instead of the regular one, regardless of the specific level.
objectTypes.allowedParentTypesHint: No selection = can be placed anywhere (default).
objectTypes.invalidAttributeName: Every attribute needs a technical name.

rules.heading: Rules
rules.hint: The constraint engine checks rules when an object of this type is created or changed (naming rule, conditions) or changes status (status transitions).
rules.namingHint: Required attributes must be set for a name to be valid. The pattern is literal text with {attribute} placeholders replaced by the attribute's value; the file extension doesn't count.
rules.patternUndeclared: The pattern uses undeclared attributes: {names}. Their placeholder matches any text.
rules.conditionsHint: When an attribute meets a condition, another one becomes required. Numbers are compared as numbers, everything else as text.
rules.rawCondition: Can't be shown in the guided form, kept unchanged:
rules.transitionsHint: A transition from one status to the next can require attributes. Without an entry every transition is allowed. Today case management checks it when closing a case (open → closed).
rules.conditionIncomplete: Condition {index} is incomplete: choose the attribute, value and required attribute.
rules.transitionIncomplete: Status transition {index} needs a from and a to status.
rules.transitionSame: Status transition {index}: from and to are the same.
rules.transitionUnknownAttribute: Status transition {index} requires the undeclared attribute "{name}".

mappings.heading: Take metadata from files
mappings.hint: When a document of this type is uploaded, properties of the file (PDF document info, Word/Excel/PowerPoint and OpenDocument properties) fill attributes. "Only if empty" fills an attribute only when nothing was entered at upload. If a taken value breaks the type's rules, it is dropped; the upload never fails because of it. Applies to new documents only, not to new versions.
mappings.unknownAttribute: Mapping {index} refers to the undeclared attribute "{name}".
mappings.typeMismatch: Mapping {index}: "{name}" can't hold this property (date attributes only from Created/Modified, otherwise text attributes only).
mappings.duplicate: Mapping {index}: "{name}" is already mapped from another property.

layoutDesigner.heading: Form layout designer
layoutDesigner.hint: Adjusts how an object type's attributes are arranged in display, search, and upload. Without customization, the automatically generated smart layout applies.
layoutDesigner.staleAttributesWarning: This saved layout still references attribute(s) that no longer exist on this object type: {attributes}. Remove or replace the affected field(s), or reset to the automatically generated layout.
layoutDesigner.emptyLayout: This layout currently contains no fields.

ocrSettings.enabledHint: Whether OCR runs at all is a deployment decision (Docker Compose profile "ocr") - only the running service's runtime-adjustable settings are here.
ocrSettings.unreachable: OCR service not reachable - likely disabled via Compose profile (ocrEnabled=false).
ocrSettings.allowedContentTypesHint: Comma-separated, e.g. "application/pdf, image/png" - applies in addition to the technical format check, empty = no restriction (allowlist: only listed content types trigger OCR).

exportSettings.hint: PDF export behavior (history position) and optional automatic stamping - affects document and folder export ("export for filing").
exportSettings.stampEnabledHint: Without activation, the export stays unchanged (default).
exportSettings.stampPositionHint: "Diagonal, centered" is only available for the "Text" stamp type - other combinations are rejected on save.
exportSettings.stampValueTemplateHint: Allowed placeholders: {document_id}, {kennzeichen}. An unknown placeholder is rejected on save.

uploadSettings.hint: The content type is determined server-side from the actual file content (not from the header sent by the browser) and checked against this list. Empty = any recognized format is accepted.
uploadSettings.allowedContentTypesHint: Comma-separated, e.g. "application/pdf, text/plain, application/json" - empty = no restriction.

processingFailures.notificationHint: Notifications (email/in-app/webhook) whose automatic delivery has finally failed after several attempts with backoff - a manual restart retries delivery immediately.
processingFailures.notificationMissingPermission: You don't have permission to view failed notifications.
processingFailures.renditionHint: Renditions (thumbnails, PDF/A,...) whose automatic generation has finally failed after several attempts with backoff - a manual restart only retries the affected renderer.
processingFailures.ocrHint: OCR runs that have finally failed after several attempts with backoff - a manual restart retries text recognition immediately.
processingFailures.handoverHint: Handover deliveries between installations that have finally failed after several attempts with backoff - either the outbound delivery to the target installation or the return delivery of the result to the sending installation. Loaded DIRECTLY from the federation hub, not via this installation's gateway (the hub is shared infrastructure, not an internal installation component).

fleetManagement.heading: Managed installations
fleetManagement.hint: Installations this fleet operator administers - reached directly at the Fleet Management Service, not through this installation's gateway (the service is shared, cross-installation infrastructure, not an internal component). Every call, including the plain list, requires the operator key. Each operator has their own token; the environment key belongs to the admin operator "bootstrap".
fleetManagement.operatorKeyPlaceholder: Required for every action on this page
fleetManagement.unreachable: Fleet Management Service not reachable or key invalid.
fleetManagement.newKeyWarning: This installation's fleet agent key (shown only now, not retrievable afterward):

groups.heading: Groups (waves)
groups.hint: A group collects installations that get an update together. A rollout can take a group as its target.
groups.name: Name

plans.heading: Update plans
plans.hint: A plan is the ordered steps of an update. A confirmation step stands for an action outside this service (maintenance mode, rolling update, backup) and is reported by the operator who performed it. A check step queries the installation's status. Steps with approval need a second operator (four-eyes principle).
plans.name: Name

rollouts.heading: Rollouts
rollouts.hint: A rollout applies a plan to its target: a group's members, plus extra and minus excluded installations. It only starts when someone starts it; the next wave is its own rollout.
rollouts.name: Name
rollouts.deleteConfirm: Delete rollout "{name}" with all its runs?
rollouts.ownProposal: Own proposal: approval needs a different operator.
rollouts.cancelConfirm: Cancel rollout "{name}"? It can't be resumed afterwards, only deleted.

actions.acknowledgeConfirm: Confirm that the plan or configuration was corrected? Only then is a new attempt possible.

operators.heading: Operators
operators.hint: Each operator has their own token, so who reports a step, approves it or starts a rollout is known. Only admin operators create or revoke operators.
operators.name: Name
operators.tokenWarning: Token for {name} (shown only now, not retrievable afterward):
operators.revokeConfirm: Revoke {name}'s token? It stops working at once.

delegationsAdmin.hint: Installation-wide overview of all delegations on record - creating one is a self-service feature (User UI), here only an overview + early revocation by an authorized admin role.
delegationsAdmin.filterOrgHierarchyOnly: Show only automatically generated org-hierarchy grants

adGroupMappings.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the change awaits approval from a second person before it takes effect.
adGroupMappings.mappingsHint: Each AD group on record here automatically grants the mapped role to all of its members - multiple rows for the same group are additive (OR).
adGroupMappings.mappingsEmpty: No AD group mappings on record.
adGroupMappings.compositeRulesHint: Several AD groups together (AND, at least two) grant a role jointly - unlike the simple mappings above, where any one alone is enough.
adGroupMappings.compositeRuleNeedsTwoGroups: At least two distinct AD group names are required.
adGroupMappings.defaultRoleHint: Granted when a principal brings AD groups but none of them appear in any mapping/rule above - a single setting, optionally protected by the four-eyes principle (installation-wide configuration).

userTracking.configHint: Fine-grained session tracking for privileged accounts - off by default, except for the activated superuser, who is always tracked regardless of this setting.
userTracking.sessionsHint: Client IP, user agent, and auth method per login/refresh - no GeoIP, no client-side fingerprinting, no stored session duration (deliberate limitation). Shows the most recent 200 entries.
userTracking.retentionHint: Own, short retention period for tracking data, separate from the regular audit log.
userTracking.retentionInvalid: Retention period must be at least 1 day.
userTracking.configPendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - the change awaits approval from a second person before it takes effect.

shareLinkSettings.hint: Installation-wide switch for time-limited, unauthenticated read-access links to individual documents. Disabling immediately locks already-issued links too, not just new ones.

retentionSettings.hint: Installation-wide base settings for forced deletion and trash - overridable per object type in the object-type editor (deletion reason requirement) or supplemented (default retention period).
retentionSettings.deletionReasonRequired: Require a deletion reason for forced deletion
retentionSettings.deletionReasonCatalogHint: Suggested deletion reasons (selection list in the User UI, in addition to a free-text "Other" field)
retentionSettings.deletionReasonCatalogEmpty: No suggestions yet - only a free-text field is shown.
retentionSettings.foldersHint: Own, independently configurable base settings for folders - an installation operator may need different rules for folders than for documents.
retentionSettings.catalogDiffHint: Documents and folders have separate settings, so whoever deletes sees different reasons depending on the object. Aligning sets both catalogues to their union – no reason is lost.

deletionRegister.hint: Every physical deletion (forced deletion or expired trash period) and every destruction of a case binder after its retention is recorded here and additionally published as a regular audit event. After a restore from a backup, the restore run reconciles against these entries so that deleted objects stay deleted. Shows documents, folders and case binders together.
deletionRegister.caseUnreachable: Case service not reachable - case binders are missing from the list.

archivalTransfers.hint: Every document whose object-type deadline has expired or which was manually triggered for disposal goes through a transfer state machine here up to the archive copy (PDF/A) and - after a transition period - removal of the live storage copy ("dehydration"). Metadata and the audit trail always remain findable throughout.
archivalTransfers.requestArchiveSuccess: Document flagged for immediate disposal - picked up on the next run of the disposal service (default: hourly).
archivalTransfers.confirmRetrieve: Retrieve document {documentId} from the archive and restore the live storage copy?
archivalTransfers.caseHint: For closed case binders, an XDOMEA 4.0.0 disposal message (message type 0503) is generated and packed into a package together with the referenced document contents. Unlike documents, there is no dehydration and no write-back - a case binder has no live storage space of its own, only a package download.
archivalTransfers.caseFullDeletionLabel: Delete fully instead of keeping a record
archivalTransfers.caseFullDeletionHint: By default a record stays: id, case number and dates are kept; name, attributes and document references are removed. The documents themselves have their own retention. Applies to case binders disposed from now on.
archivalTransfers.destructionHint: Disposed case binders whose retention has expired are destroyed automatically and recorded in the deletion register. If a referenced document is under active quarantine, the destruction waits until the quarantine is lifted.
archivalTransfers.destructionUnreachable: Destruction runs could not be loaded.

reports.empty: No data for the selected period/filter.
reports.schedulesHint: Regenerates the selected report on a recurring basis and sends an email with a download link via the notification service (no attachment).

forensicTrace.hint: Object-related tracing — shows every action a person, document, or folder was involved in. Central use case: if an account is suspected of being compromised, trace exactly what that person did. Every query is itself audited again.
forensicTrace.empty: No matches for the selected filters.
forensicTrace.filteredHint: {visible} of {total} events visible (the rest is hidden by your permissions).
forensicTrace.subject: Object

queryConsole.hint: Central query & trace console — federated read access to the audit trail. Every query runs under the security context of the executing person: result rows for which there is no read permission on the associated folder are automatically hidden. Every query is itself audited again.
queryConsole.empty: No (visible) matches for the selected filters.
queryConsole.filteredHint: {visible} of {total} events visible (the rest is hidden by your permissions).
queryConsole.subject: Object
queryConsole.manipulationHint: Write queries — a curated catalog of structural actions instead of free-form SQL text. Every action must first be simulated (dry run) before it can be executed; critical actions (permission/role tables, object-type/constraint definitions) always require a second approval, even for the activated superuser.
queryConsole.manipulationValueParseError: New value is not valid JSON.
queryConsole.criticalBadge: Critical action — always requires a second approval.
queryConsole.pendingApprovalResult: Approval request created — a second person must approve it (see table below).

auditTraceSettings.hint: Controls how deeply read access to documents is logged for the forensic trace. The base applies to everyone unless one of their roles has an override. On conflicting role overrides, "log" wins.
auditTraceSettings.overridesHint: A role without an override follows the base configuration above.

kennzeichenSettings.hint: Global default for whether an automatically assigned file reference number is shown before the filename. Individual document classes can override this default in the object-type editor.
kennzeichenSettings.showBeforeFilename: Show file reference number before filename

configPackages.hint: A configuration package is a curated, versioned configuration document - e.g. the eGov configuration package. Application runs through the existing, secured configuration import (additive/upsert, repeatably applicable). The preview before applying shows what would change without changing anything yet.
configPackages.invalidDocument: Not a valid configuration file (missing or invalid JSON, no 'schema_version' field).
configPackages.noManifest: No manifest - a plain configuration document with no name/version/description.
configPackages.pendingApproval: Four-eyes principle active - applying the package awaits approval by a second person before it happens.
configPackages.deltaOnlyInSystem: Only in the current system (stays unchanged)

configCompare.hint: Compares the active installation's configuration against another known installation - e.g. for drift detection between staging and production. Field-level comparison (no deep structural check) - a change deep inside an object-type layout is reported as 'the entire layout differs', not row-precise.
configCompare.baseIsActive: Base is the active installation ({name}) - its current, live-fetched configuration.
configCompare.noOtherInstallations: No other installation known - add a second installation under "Installation management" first.
configCompare.compareError: Comparison failed - check the other installation's credentials or reachability.
configCompare.ignoreRegexHint: Field names matching this pattern are skipped across every category during comparison.

storageGuard.hint: Whether the storage service automatically refuses to start or starts degraded on a detected media change. The target set itself (which backends/credentials are configured) is deployment configuration, not editable here - object lock/disposal role per already-configured target have been live-editable, taking effect without a restart.
storageGuard.unreachable: Storage service not reachable - possibly due to a refused start after a detected media change (see server log).
storageGuard.confirmDecommission: Decommission target "{targetId}"? All copy rows for this target will be removed - an object whose only confirmed copy is here blocks decommissioning instead.
storageGuard.allowDegradedStart: Allow degraded start if at least one target is verifiably unchanged
storageGuard.confirmReidentify: Accept the media change for target "{targetId}"? All existing copies on this target will be flagged for re-replication.

superuser.hint: Superuser access is disabled by default. Activation requires two different people with the "Superuser break-glass release group" role: one requests it, a second approves it.
superuser.requestSent: Approval request created (ID: {id}) - a second person with the release role must approve it.

result.pending_approval: Approval request created - a second person with the "Not-shutdown trigger" role must approve it.

maintenanceBanner.text: System-wide emergency lockdown active - only the activated superuser can act.

registry.hint: The registry forgets replaced instances by itself; each forget is in the audit trail (registry.instance.forgotten).
registry.invalidRange: At least 1, and at most must not be below at least.
registry.forgetConfirm: Forget instance {id}? If it is still running, it registers again on its next heartbeat.

sensors.readOnly: Read-only: changes need the role "Monitoring/sensor configuration" (admin.monitoring).

global.heading: Base setting
global.hint: The starting point for every sensor without its own, group or cost setting. A sensor that is off generates no data in its service at all. Every change is audited.

cost.heading: By cost
cost.hint: Every sensor has a cost level from 1 (very cheap) to 5 (very expensive): the work per measurement and the number of series it produces. Levels can be switched together, for example the expensive ones off in continuous operation. A group or sensor setting takes precedence. Sensors that are off by default need to be switched on explicitly, even under "monitor everything".

list.heading: Groups and sensors
list.hint: The most specific setting applies: sensor before group before cost before the base setting. The catalog comes from the running services.
list.filter: Filter by name, description or service

orphaned.heading: Settings without a running sensor
orphaned.hint: These settings belong to sensors or groups no service reports right now (stopped or renamed). They apply again once the sensor is back.

tracing.heading: Tracing
tracing.hint: Share of requests recorded as a trace across every service (Grafana → Tempo). The first service of a request decides, all others follow it. Changes apply within 15 seconds.
tracing.saved: Saved – the services pick the value up with their next poll.
tracing.invalid: Please enter a value between 0 and 100.
tracing.notConfigured: No trace collector is configured for this monitoring-service (DMS_OTEL_EXPORTER_ENDPOINT) – the value takes effect once tracing is switched on.

logLevels.heading: Log levels
logLevels.hint: Set log levels centrally: for all services, one service or a single logger (with its child loggers). Every replica of a service applies a change within 15 seconds. DEBUG always expires (default {defaultMinutes} min, at most {maxHours} h) because it can write personal data. Without a setting a service runs on its DMS_LOG_LEVEL.
logLevels.none: No central settings – every service runs on its DMS_LOG_LEVEL.
logLevels.removed: Removed – the services apply it with their next poll.
logLevels.saved: Saved – every replica applies it within 15 seconds.

license.hint: Install a signed license file and view current usage per dimension. An exceeded limit does not block existing data but prevents new creations.
license.bannerNotInstalled: No license installed - restricted operation (demo mode/lock per component).
license.showHints: Show licence extension hints in the navigation

workflow-service.name: Processes & routing folders
workflow-service.benefit: Approvals, circulations and deadlines as guided processes instead of e-mail.

webdav-connector.name: Direct Office editing & network drive
webdav-connector.benefit: Open and save documents directly in Word/Excel, mount the repository as a network drive.

migration-service.name: Migration & transfer
migration-service.benefit: Take over holdings from legacy systems and file shares, verified and logged.

cmis-connector.name: CMIS interface
cmis-connector.benefit: Connect line-of-business and third-party systems via the CMIS standard.

license.noLicensableComponents: This installation has no licensable add-on components.

installations.hint: Each installation is fully isolated and needs its own login - afterward you can switch between already-logged-in installations without logging in again, as long as the respective session is valid.
installations.name: Name

mailboxes.hint: The mailboxes the inbox retrieves. Changes apply from the next retrieval, without a restart. Passwords are stored encrypted and never shown.
mailboxes.name: Name
mailboxes.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

realmRoles.hint: Realm roles control access to whole applications or areas, e.g. "dms-poststelle" for the inbox. They are independent of the permission roles below, which grant permissions on resources. A change applies from the person's next login.

alerts.noRules: No alert rules for this sensor.

form.name: Name
form.repeatHint: A level counts once it was measured that many times in a row (one measurement per minute). An error not yet measured often enough counts as a warning.
form.sensorOff: This sensor is off - the rule stays "unknown" until it is switched on.

preview.no_samples: No samples - sensor off, service unreachable or the filter matches nothing.
preview.rate_needs_history: A rate needs two measurements; the value appears after the saved rule's first evaluation.

problems.noThreshold: At least one threshold is needed.
problems.order: Thresholds must ascend: error below ≤ warning below ≤ warning above ≤ error above.

active.heading: Active alarms
active.noRules: No alert rules yet - they are set up per sensor in the table below.

windows.heading: Maintenance windows
windows.hint: While a window is active no alarm mails are sent; evaluation continues. If an alarm still holds after the window, the mail comes then.
windows.name: Name
windows.weeklyHint: Times in the installation's time zone; an end before the start spans midnight.

modeHint.off: Only the object types' existing rules (allowed parent classes) apply.
modeHint.report: All rules are checked but nothing is refused. Violations go to the log and the report below – for introducing a structure.
modeHint.enforce: What the structure doesn't allow is refused (upload, create, move, WebDAV, CMIS, mailroom).

structure.listEmptyHint: Nothing selected: nothing is allowed here then, not even untyped objects.
structure.overviewHint: How the rules add up from top to bottom. Below open levels, only classes that explicitly name that level as their parent appear.
structure.warningUnreachable: "{child}" is allowed under "{parent}" but doesn't allow that parent itself – it can never be created there.
structure.warningOrphan: "{name}" can't be created anywhere: no level allows this class.
structure.reportHeading: Report: what doesn't fit the structure?
structure.reportHint: Existing folders and documents measured against the current rules – whatever the mode. Nothing is locked. Selected entries can be given another type here; each one is checked individually.
structure.reportSummary: {checked} checked, {nonconforming} deviate: {placement}× wrong place, {missing}× required attributes missing, {unknown}× type deleted.
structure.templatesHint: Templates create a whole folder structure at once. Users only see a template where its top folder is allowed. Under classes with "only from templates" it is the only way to create subfolders.
structure.captureTemplate: Take over from an existing folder
structure.templateNamesRequired: The template and every folder need a name.
structure.templateCaptured: Structure of "{name}" taken over – adjust the name and save.
structure.pickerHint: Choose the folder whose structure is taken over:
structure.classHint: What may be created below a folder of this class. Applies once the mode on the "Filing structure" page isn't "Off". The child's allowed parent classes must fit as well.
structure.defaultsHint: The defaults apply when something is created without an object type, e.g. via WebDAV, CMIS or the mailroom. Required attributes aren't demanded then; the report lists them until they are filled in.
structure.defaultFolderNotListed: The subfolder default "{name}" isn't selected in the list.
structure.defaultDocumentNotListed: The document default "{name}" isn't selected in the list.

incomingSignatures.switchesHint: Signatures in newly filed PDFs are checked automatically; the result appears on the document. A broken signature never blocks filing.
incomingSignatures.euTrustedLists: Use the EU trusted lists (only they can confirm "qualified")
incomingSignatures.outboundFetching: Fetch revocation lists and certificates from the internet (fenced, public addresses only)
incomingSignatures.revocationMode: When the revocation status can't be obtained
incomingSignatures.trustedListsHint: The EU list of the lists and the member states' lists. Only what passes the signature check is stored; without internet access the XML files can be imported (the list of the lists first).
incomingSignatures.anchorsHint: CA certificates this installation trusts – for example a partner authority's PKI. Signatures based on them count as "trusted (installation)", never as qualified.
incomingSignatures.removeConfirm: Remove trust anchor "{name}"? Earlier results stay as they are.
incomingSignatures.backfillHint: Checks existing PDF versions filed before switching on or during an outage – by time range and/or one folder's documents (not its subfolders).
incomingSignatures.backfillLimit: Limit reached – start again for the rest.

backfillState.running: Running: {scanned} versions seen, {queued} queued, {skipped} already checked.
backfillState.done: Done: {scanned} versions seen, {queued} queued, {skipped} already checked; {pending} checks still pending.

workflowInstances.intro: Correct running cases administratively: skip an open task, send the case back to a completed step, or migrate it to a newer process version. Every intervention needs a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
workflowInstances.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you intervening in this case?
workflowInstances.reasonHint: Required (at least 3 characters) – applies to the next intervention.
workflowInstances.notRunning: The instance is no longer running.
workflowInstances.noCompleted: No completed task to send the case back to yet.
workflowInstances.noNewerVersion: There is no newer version of this process.
workflowInstances.reportPossible: Migration possible – every active task has a counterpart.
workflowInstances.claimsReleased: {count} claim(s) released, the people affected were notified.
workflowInstances.terminateHint: Cancels every open step and ends the instance for good. It does not count as completed; a case waiting for it stays open.
workflowInstances.terminateConfirm: Really terminate this instance? This cannot be undone.
